headline: early
notes: Truth is strict: an alert counts as a true positive only when at least half of its transfers are laundering.
Cases routed to analyst review count as escalated, because an analyst works them.
The held-out alerts were never used to tune the prompts. The development alerts were, so the development numbers may be optimistic.
The two runs used different prompt versions (v5 on the held-out alerts, v3 on the development alerts), so they are not a like-for-like comparison.
The numbers are small: the early held-out set has 13 true positives, so one case moves the result a lot.
The reviewer agent was off for the held-out run, so no second agent checked its recommendations.
The model is a free model (nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b:free), so the cost per case was $0.
In this synthetic dataset most transfers after 2022-09-10 are laundering, so late alerts are easy to call. The headline uses only alerts that end on or before 2022-09-10.

rules_171.population: All 171 alerts raised by rules v1, development and held out together. A different population from the splits above.
